_comment: Magnifier-rail waivers (tools/check_magnifier_rails.mjs, docs/models.md 'Magnifiers on the rail'): { gun: { maxMm, why } }. A waived gun's feet may hang off its rail up to maxMm and print as warnings; more is an error, and every other gun stays an error over 3 mm. Only for the guns that failed when the check came in (2026-11-08): move the sight forward (optF / optFMag) or lengthen the rail, then remove the entry (a waiver whose gun passes warns 'no longer needed').
